title: First-class pattern packages
goal: Give every Pattern a clickable authoring route backed by a colocated definition for metadata, HTML, CSS, and pattern-specific settings.

nodes.title: Build the pattern package module
nodes.goal: Define the shared pattern interface and move all four current definitions into local folders behind a registry and compiler.
acceptanceChecks: Every definition owns metadata, HTML, CSS, and controls
Callers use the registry and shared engine
Unsafe CSS retains the last valid state

nodes.title: Build shared Pattern authoring
nodes.goal: Use one dynamic route and shared Settings and Preview UI for every pattern.
acceptanceChecks: All four tiles open their own route
Each route shows its own settings
HTML, CSS, settings, and Preview stay coherent

nodes.title: Verify Pattern packages
nodes.goal: Verify all routes, settings, persistence, scaling, accessibility, responsiveness, tests, check, and build.
acceptanceChecks: Desktop and mobile browser checks pass
No unresolved blocking diff finding remains
